name: Flick Compass
summary: Hold anywhere and a brass compass rose blooms; flick toward a page and it slides in from that side
about: A marking menu for a sailing log with eight pages, one at each point of the compass. Press and hold anywhere and a brass rose blooms under your finger with a springy needle that chases your aim; let go on a point and the needle clacks, the rose flies off and the new page sweeps in from that direction with a wash of foam. Quick flicks skip the menu, and the pages work: crew watches, a log you can add to, a gear checklist and notes.
how: Press and hold on the page, drag toward a point of the rose and let go; let go in the middle to cancel.
Once you know the way, just flick quickly in a direction without waiting.
Or press the round compass button (or right-click), then use the arrow keys or 1 to 8 and Enter; Escape closes.
A ghost finger demo plays by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
